text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan's friends had gathered in the 
stands for the Copa Republica Argentina.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer and Daitaku Helios. Along 
with... the gyaru Umamusume who had 
recently become Tosen Jordan's friends.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Checking the encouraging messages from 
them on her phone, Tosen Jordan headed off 
to her race.
